item.title: 🚨 President Aoun : -The negotiations are making progress and, in all circumstances, remain better th
item.description:
🚨
President Aoun :
-The negotiations are making progress and, in all circumstances, remain better than the outcome of the devastating wars against us. The scale of israeli attacks on our country has been reduced following the signing of the framework formula, which has had a positive impact on Lebanese people returning to spend the summer in their homeland.
-There is no disagreement among the Lebanese over the objectives, namely the israeli withdrawal, the return of the prisoners, and the reconstruction of what was destroyed. Ultimately, we will not allow israel to remain on even one inch of our land, nor will we allow a single one of its soldiers to remain on our soil.
-We constantly hear slogans saying that what was taken by force can only be recovered by force, but the facts on the ground have proven this saying false.
-It is time for the people of the South to live in peace and stability on their land, instead of wars continuing to be waged in their name for non-Lebanese objectives.
-My goal today is to rebuild the state, whatever the cost, despite opposition from those seeking to undermine the foundations of the state and prevent its reconstruction.
